_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see check_gate.py and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-08-05. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python3 benchmarks/binary_size/check_gate.py --update Last raised 2026-08-05 by M1.0, which widened comparison dispatch from NumericType to PrimitiveType: query_streaming +0.512%, query_join +1.154%. That is the cost of emitting comparison leaves for temporal, interval and decimal -- i.e. of supporting those dtypes at all -- and it buys row-group pruning on date and decimal predicates, which ClickBench needs.
